blind.description: A dark cast-bronze or cast-iron cauldron standing on three or four clawed feet, filled with a bubbling brown stew containing orange carrot chunks, pale potato/turnip cubes, herbs, and a wooden spoon or ladle handle protruding from the liquid. The pot has a rounded belly, a wide rim, and ring-shaped handles on the sides with ornate bracket mountings. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with no holes or floating shards.
blind.from_above: From straight above it appears as a concentric circular dark rim framing a brown bubbling stew with orange carrot cubes, yellowish potato pieces, green herbs, and a tilted wooden spoon handle emerging near the upper-right edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2 to 2.5 ft tall (reaching around knee or mid-thigh height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2 to 2.5 ft in diameter.
